defect: case analysis fixes an internally toggling bank selector
rationale: bank_sel toggles on every active clock after reset and selects both banks in normal operation. set_case_analysis forces it to zero, pruning timing through bank_b although that bank is sampled on alternate cycles. It is not an immutable mode strap.
author: gpt-6.1-sol

labels.note: set_case_analysis 0 on bank_sel ties a register that toggles every cycle, disabling timing of the live bank_b -> output_q path.
